films.title: Absentia
films.overview: Tricia's husband has been missing for seven years. Her younger sister Callie comes to live with her as the pressure mounts to finally declare him 'dead in absentia'. Tricia is reluctant, always holding out hope, but Callie is practical and wants her to move on. As Tricia sifts through the wreckage and tries to move on with her life, Callie finds herself drawn to an ominous tunnel near the house.

films.title: Oculus
films.overview: A woman tries to exonerate her brother's murder conviction by proving that the crime was committed by a supernatural phenomenon.

films.title: Before I Wake
films.overview: An orphaned child's dreams—and nightmares—manifest physically as he sleeps.

films.title: Gerald's Game
films.overview: When her husband's sex game goes wrong, Jessie (who is handcuffed to a bed in a remote lake house) faces warped visions, dark secrets and a dire choice.

films.title: Hush
films.overview: A deaf woman is stalked by a psychotic killer in her secluded home.

films.title: Ouija: Origin of Evil
films.overview: In 1967 Los Angeles, a widowed mother and her two daughters add a new stunt to bolster their séance scam business and unwittingly invite authentic evil into their home. When the youngest daughter is overtaken by the merciless spirit, this small family confronts unthinkable fears to save her and send her possessor back to the other side.

films.title: Doctor Sleep
films.overview: Still scarred by the trauma he endured as a child at the Overlook Hotel, Dan Torrance faces the ghosts of the past when he meets Abra, a courageous teen who desperately needs his help -- and who possesses a powerful extrasensory ability called the "shine".

films.title: The Life of Chuck
films.overview: In this extraordinary story of an ordinary man, Charles 'Chuck' Krantz experiences the wonder of love, the heartbreak of loss, and the multitudes contained in all of us.
